statement: SDL 3.2.10 Plus MP-only opens the exact-owned HIDAPI joystick during a 60-second poll with no disconnect/removal. An explicit concurrent kernel MP-event holder sees changing gyro. SDL exposes no gyro sensor (capable false, enabled false, zero samples). No changing decoded SDL gyro is established; capability or successful value polling is not delivery. The underlying virtual gyro is not physically zero and no model fix follows. This is a bounded consumer observation with a holder precondition, not general SDL acceptance.

applicability.revision: Tr / virtual Wii Remote Plus, Bluetooth PID 0330; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Plus-specific kernel-bound software experiment at P1 code PR head; no Original inheritance. Source default built-in identity, caller synthetic calibration, no physical/radio/rate/game/challenge evidence. #258 release gate remains for special-driver windows.
